events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Chelsea 1, Bournemouth 0. Jordan Henderson (Chelsea) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Cole Palmer.
Goal! Chelsea 2, Bournemouth 0. Morgan Rogers (Chelsea) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Jordan Henderson.
Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Chelsea 2, Bournemouth 0.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Ben Gannon-Doak replaces David Brooks.

Goal! Chelsea 3, Bournemouth 1. Evanilson (Bournemouth) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chelsea 4, Bournemouth 1. João Pedro (Chelsea) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Pep Chavarría with a cross.
Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Chelsea 5, Bournemouth 1. Jordan Henderson (Chelsea) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
